name: sherpa
description: Agent workflows for the MCP server of Sherpa.app: Apple Calendar, Reminders, Mail, iMessage and local KakaoTalk on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Calendar, Reminders, Mail and messages through Sherpa.app
interface.longDescription: Connects the agent to the MCP server of Sherpa.app, which reads and changes Apple Calendar and Reminders with native read-back, reads Mail, iMessage and the local KakaoTalk database in bounded ranges, and asks the person in its own window before a delete or a send.
